posts.title: Shell tools for writers
posts.description: The command line is a text-based interface, and writing is a text-based activity. Shell tools, therefore, are writing tools. Here are some examples that have served me. All scripts assume GNU versions and the Bash shell. Find and replace Replace all instances of an old phrase within a set of MD files.
